response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced software craftsman with strong architecture, Node.js, and DLang skills, but lacks the deep, recent C++ and STL expertise required for this Senior C++ Developer role. Furthermore, there is no evidence of experience with industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443) or specific industrial automation protocols (MQTT, Modbus) crucial for this position.
strengths: Extensive overall software engineering experience (15+ years) with a strong focus on software craftsmanship, TDD, and agile practices.
Strong background in building scalable, event-driven architectures and high-performance microservices.
Possesses several advantageous skills listed in the job description, including Node.js, React, and cloud exposure.
concerns: Severe lack of recent or extensive C++ and STL experience, with only 7 months of professional C/C++ work dating back to 2015.
No demonstrated experience with industrial automation protocols (Modbus, OPC UA) or IoT message brokers like MQTT.
Missing required security expertise, specifically Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL) and IEC 62443 industrial-cybersecurity standards.
